## 02 · Yellowdig Normalize and Join
Input: the source bundle from **01**. Output: one **week dataset** (schemas/week-dataset.schema.json).

No AI. Every number comes from `web/src/lib/metrics.ts` and `web/src/lib/source/normalize.ts`, bundled into these Code nodes.
Missing parents and unknown event types are reported in `diagnostics` and `orphans`, never guessed.

The manual trigger runs 01 in **fixture** mode for testing.

nodeGroups.name: Normalize and join
nodeGroups.description: Contract check, classify, join to posts, code-counted metrics, schema check. No AI nodes.

observatory.note: Credentials, pinned data, webhook ids and instance metadata removed. Code nodes are generated; see web/scripts/build-n8n.ts.
